notes: 1st edition by Deloitte's count ('started in 2001 with ten predictions about mobile telephony'). 'm-Predictions: the top mobile Hot Topics for 2002', a four-page Deloitte Consulting paper, captured by the Internet Archive on 2002-01-29 at dc.com. Ten numbered predictions, all captured; none carries a number. Identification as the first TMT Predictions edition rests on the match with Deloitte's description (ten mobile predictions, written 2001); the paper itself does not use the TMT Predictions name. Published month inferred from the capture date. Rank is the printed number.

entries.title: Business mobile take-up will accelerate
entries.quote: The last perceived barrier to adoption of mobile applications has disappeared. And organisations across the globe now see mobile as a reliable and viable platform for business processes.

entries.note: Read from the Internet Archive copy of the Deloitte Consulting PDF 'm-Predictions: the top mobile Hot Topics for 2002'.
